title: Photographs

description.main: The catalogue for Christopher Williams's 2025 exhibition at The Perimeter, London, designed by Williams with Petra Hollenbach. It gathers a selection of his photographs with a critical essay, 'Model Models', by the art historian Stephanie Schwartz.
description.extended:
Photographs is the catalogue for Christopher Williams's 2025 exhibition at The Perimeter in London, his first public solo exhibition in the city since his Whitechapel Gallery presentation in 2015.

The exhibition, Hand Painted Signs, Photographs, Long Play Vinyl, Audiophile Bar, Printed Matter, ran from 10 October to 20 December 2025. It was built around a reading of The Perimeter's collection and included hand-painted signs, photographs, films, a radio play and an open letter. The softcover catalogue, designed by Williams with Petra Hollenbach, presents a selection of his images over 80 pages with 35 illustrations. It also contains 'Model Models', a critical essay by the art historian Stephanie Schwartz. The book was co-published with Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther und Franz König in Cologne.

Williams was born in Los Angeles in 1956 and lives and works in Cologne and Los Angeles. From 2008 to 2023 he was Professor of Photography at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf. His photographs adopt the precision of commercial, advertising and fashion photography to show how images are constructed and circulated. The London show was one of a series of Williams exhibitions opening across Europe that year.
